name: Youth Climate Leadership Program (YCLP)
what_you_do: Teens go to youth climate summits in their region. They run local Climate Action Projects, such as pushing for solar panels at school. They also serve on teams that plan events for the community.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 8 to 12, generally 13 to 18.
pay_detail: The two upcoming summits are free to attend.
duration: Projects take a couple of hours a month. Leadership teams meet every other week before summits and monthly otherwise.
deadline_text: No deadline. Upcoming summits: Western Mass Monday Nov 9, 2026 and SouthCoast Friday Nov 20, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the YCLP contact form on the Mass Audubon site. Staff connect you with your local chapter. A local adult mentor helps you start.
notes: Upcoming summits are free: Western Mass on Monday Nov 9, 2026 in Springfield, and SouthCoast on Friday Nov 20, 2026 in Dartmouth. Ages 13 to 17.
